title: Legal Forwarding Standing and Late Charges on Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
A legal standing adjustment applies to the late charge on a past-due fee invoice of an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements by the client's legal forwarding agreement that names this contingency agreement — the client's holding under the Legal Forwarding Agreements: a 10 percent relief where that legal agreement is active and its cost deposit is at or above the programme's cost deposit minimum balance, a 10 percent surcharge where it is suspended and its cost deposit is below that minimum, and nothing otherwise.

**Records read.** The legal forwarding agreement's status and its cost deposit balance, from that agreement's record, and the cost deposit minimum balance of its legal programme — the deposit balance below which the client must replenish.

**How it acts.** The reliefs and the adjustment that apply to the late charge are first added into one share, and the charge is reduced once by that share; they do not act one after another, and the result is rounded to the cent once at the end. A relief enters the share as a reduction; the surcharge enters it as a negative reduction, so that on its own it raises the charge by 10 percent.

## Desk card

| Legal forwarding agreement naming this contingency agreement | Cost deposit against the programme minimum | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| active | at or above the minimum | 10 percent relief |
| active | below the minimum | nothing |
| suspended | below the minimum | 10 percent surcharge |
| suspended | at or above the minimum | nothing |
| any other status, or none held | — | nothing |

## Hypothetical figures

Programme cost deposit minimum 2500.00 USD; late charge before any relief or adjustment 20.00 USD, nothing else applying.

- Active, deposit 2500.00 USD (exactly the minimum): relief 10 percent, charge 18.00 USD.
- Active, deposit 2499.99 USD: nothing, charge 20.00 USD.
- Suspended, deposit 1800.00 USD: surcharge 10 percent, charge 22.00 USD.
- Suspended, deposit 3000.00 USD: nothing, charge 20.00 USD.
